description: The creators on your watchlist: handle, platform, your note, when you added them and when you last caught up on them, and which saved creator identity (one person's accounts) each belongs to, grouped in `byIdentity`. Reads the stored list only — nothing is fetched, so there is no cost. Use it to answer 'who am I watching?', or to find the exact handle and platform unwatch_creator needs, before paying for catch_up_watchlist. No cost to call.
name: list_watchlist
title: List Watchlist
